name: RideHub - Customer
description: Book rides instantly with RideHub. The fastest and most reliable ride-hailing app for your daily commute.
fullDescription:
Welcome to RideHub - The Future of Urban Mobility

RideHub is a cutting-edge ride-hailing application designed to provide you with safe, reliable, and affordable transportation at your fingertips.

✨ KEY FEATURES:

🚗 Quick Booking
Book a ride in just 3 taps. Choose from multiple vehicle options - Economy, Premium, and XL.

💰 Transparent Pricing
See exact fares before booking. No hidden charges. Multiple payment options including cash, cards, and digital wallets.

🛡️ Safety First
All drivers are verified and background-checked. Share your trip details with friends and family. Emergency button for quick assistance.

⭐ Quality Drivers
Rate your driver and help us maintain the highest standards. Professional and courteous drivers.

📍 Real-time Tracking
Track your ride in real-time. Know exactly when your driver arrives.

🎁 Rewards Program
Earn points on every ride. Redeem points for free rides and exclusive offers.

24/7 Customer Support
Our dedicated support team is available round the clock to assist you.

🌍 Available Nationwide
Book rides across multiple cities with one account.
